title: Every Salesperson Has a Wish List. AI Just Made It Possible.
angle_summary: Part 1 (pillar) of Jim's series on AI and personalization at scale in B2B sales: the two questions (what do you hate most / what would you do with unlimited time), the unlimited-time prospecting list, why personalization at scale failed before, what changed, the relevant-not-creepy rule, and the series roadmap.

title: Does Claude Remember Your Conversations Now? What B2B Teams Need to Know
angle_summary: Anthropic unified Claude's memory across Claude.ai chat and Cowork (on by default, late August 2026 update). Angle: what it means for continuity in B2B ops/sales workflows, how it differs from Claude's data-training privacy policy, and how to manage it.
